verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or examples showing that LangGraph nodes use a provider-agnostic model interface (e.g., a single call that can swap between OpenAI, Anthropic, etc. without code changes); it focuses on graph structure, checkpointing, streaming, and human-in-the-loop features, not model abstraction. A stray community comment about 'bring your own keys' apps is too thin and non-technical to establish this capability. missing for 10: any docs on a unified chat-model interface, model-swap examples, or provider abstraction demonstrating no-rewrite portability.
